title: RegionTelemetry
description: Aggregated telemetry for a single region. `regionHost` and `regionName` are taken from the region's entry in regions.json (`host` / `name`). Each of the four rooms is an array of the raw telemetry items MAPI sent, with `timestampLastChanged` (epoch-ms of that item's last change) merged onto each item; AirVehicleTelemetry items additionally carry `videoUrls`.

AirVehicleTelemetry.description: Air vehicles in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI airVehicle telemetry plus videoUrls and timestampLastChanged.

GimbalsTelemetry.description: Gimbals in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI gimbal telemetry plus timestampLastChanged.

MissionsTelemetry.description: Missions in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI mission telemetry plus timestampLastChanged.

UserMessages.description: User messages in this region. Each item is the raw MAPI user message plus timestampLastChanged.
